revisions.summary: Draft Step 1 capture: sole explicit creative pin is LRS replication. App Service and Cosmos explicitly have no SKU preference. On-demand only, dev only, no environment override. No architecture-derived configuration or prices. Validation and checkpoint success are tracked separately.

Current DEV architect selections from three COMPLETE comparison-only pricing results; original LRS lock and Step 1 commit metadata preserved. Supporting access/network/recovery scope remains subject to confirmation; no prices written into manifest and no SKU or Architecture approval inferred.

services.sla_achieved: 99.9% service-credit availability threshold for Standard Hot LRS; November 2026 Microsoft Online Services SLA. Not achieved workload availability.
services.notes: Explicit LRS replication-only user pin from requirements-96146349-03a9-41ce-b41a-d78c77f2f5ac; Project Stakeholders, dev only. Original lock/source_step/commit provenance unchanged. Architecture completes one Standard GPv2 account with provider SKU Standard_LRS, Hot block blobs, no HNS, private endpoint, shared/public access disabled, Entra/MI and TLS. This is an eligibility-forced performance/account shape for Blob PITR, not a change to the replication lock or an invented premium alternative. Actual selected recovery is PITR 30 days; soft delete and change feed at least 31 days, version lifecycle must retain all required recoverable versions. Adopted aggregate retained versions/soft-deletions 10 GB and change-feed 0.5 GB are planning assumptions from the displayed data profile, not a seven-day fallback or measured churn; explicitly re-evaluate over-retention and actual churn at planning/testing. No project geo-replication. Assumed Corp policies—not tenant-verified; DEV Architecture-only.

services.sla_achieved: 99.95% non-zone-redundant paid App Service service-credit uptime threshold; November 2026 Microsoft Online Services SLA. Not tested availability or an end-to-end guarantee.
services.notes: Linux container, one B1 host at 730 hours/month. Selected from COMPLETE app-host comparison; B2 is supported scale-up alternative. Peak app memory 768 MiB plus 40% platform headroom fits 1792 MiB; CPU/concurrency/20 RPS and API latency require application-team load verification. Always On; no slots, autoscale, zone redundancy, built-in filesystem-backup or Production availability promised. ACR Premium MI image pull uses configuration routing through VNet; runtime private data uses integration subnet. Do not depend on eighty-hour access NAT for 730-hour host operation. Final SKU confirmation pending. Assumed Corp policies—not tenant-verified; DEV Architecture-only.
